name: Tatsuno (Nagano, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tatsuno town emblem in green: a disc bearing the character 辰 with a white notch at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Tatsuno, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1956.

features.role: Tatsuno town emblem — a disc bearing the character 辰 with a white notch at the bottom
